comment: With !verbose, the Wizard takes off and wears her cloak and un-wields her staff from the inventory menu. invent.c ddoinv() calls dispinv_with_action(), which hands the picked item to iactions.c itemactions(), whose itemactions_pushkeys() queues the command and the item letter, and invent.c getobj() takes the letter from cmdq_pop() without a prompt.
